Jagan criticizes Naidu government over SHG bank credit decline

YSRCP chief Jagan Mohan Reddy has accused the current Naidu government of failing Self-Help Group (SHG) women. He alleges a significant decline in SHG bank credit, stating that women beneficiaries have been deprived of approximately ₹6,000 crore over the past two years due to a lack of interest subvention on loans. This criticism highlights concerns about financial support for women's self-help groups.
